target.label: Node to test the exit through
target.none: do not test the exit through a node

run.hint: The check sends packets from the router and leaves lines in the sing-box log.

idle.title: No check has run yet
idle.description: Press “Check”: the panel tests the interception ports, DNS through dns-in, the nft chains, the exit through the chosen node and the direct exit.

reason.model_unavailable: the metabox.dataplane interception settings in UCI could not be read
reason.interception_disabled: interception is off — there is no need for ports and chains
reason.not_listening: nothing listens on the port: sing-box is stopped or the config has no such inbound
reason.proc_unavailable: could not read the socket list in /proc/net
reason.config_missing: there is no sing-box config on the device
reason.no_dns_inbound: the config has no dns-in on the interception DNS port: dnsmasq sends queries to an empty port
reason.dns_name_unset: no name is set for the DNS probe
reason.no_answer: the DNS probe got no answer
reason.nft_unparsed: the nft output could not be parsed
reason.proxy_missing: the running sing-box has no such node
reason.unsupported: the check is not supported on this system
